sections.h2: Co-firing needs 15–20 million tonnes a year; national output is about 2.5 million

chart.title: Pellet and briquette output falls well short of what the mandate needs
chart.sub: Million tonnes a year. Production is a national estimate; the need covers all obligated plants.
chart.source: Ministry of Power; CAQM, as cited in the post.

sections.means: National pellet and briquette output is about 2.5 million tonnes a year, against the 15–20 million tonnes the mandate needs.
sections.todo: Fund collection and pellet capacity so the 12–17 million tonne gap between output and mandate narrows.

sections.h2: Punjab's machinery programme cut Kharif stubble-burning incidents by 53% in one year

chart.title: Kharif stubble-burning incidents fell 53% in Punjab in a single year
chart.sub: Kharif-season stubble-burning incidents in Punjab, by year.
chart.source: Punjab state figures, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Punjab's ₹395 crore of CRM machinery was linked to a reported 53% drop in Kharif stubble-burning incidents, from 2024 to 2025.
sections.todo: Extend the machinery model beyond Punjab, since the post finds the national pellet shortfall persists.

sections.h2: Biomass-fired steam is roughly 50 gCO₂e/MJ against 70 for coal, a fuel-switch credit

chart.title: Switching a distillery boiler from coal to biomass cuts steam carbon intensity
chart.sub: gCO₂e per MJ of process steam; distillery-side estimates, not independently verified.

sections.means: Distillery-side estimates put biomass-fired steam near 50 gCO₂e/MJ against roughly 70 for coal, a creditable fuel-switch gap under BM IN02.001.
